scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore:rules
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project savvypiggy-rules-test --config firebase.test.json "node firestore.rules.test.mjs"
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && cap open android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && node scripts/build-apk.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && node scripts/build-apk.mjs assembleRelease
